description: This file is a React component for the main page of a notes application, implementing note listing, editing, creating, deleting, searching, tagging, and autosaving features.

methods.name: formatListDate
methods.description: Format ISO date string into a localized, human-readable date string.

methods.name: deriveTitle
methods.description: Derives the display title of a note, prioritizing the title, then first line of content, otherwise 'Untitled'.

methods.name: normalizeTags
methods.description: Normalize a raw comma-separated string into an array of unique, trimmed tags, case-insensitive.

methods.name: refreshList
methods.description: Fetches the list of notes from API, sorts them, and updates state.

methods.name: createNewNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with default title and adds it to the state list.

methods.name: deleteSelected
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected note after user confirmation.

methods.name: debouncedAutosave
methods.description: Debounced function to autosave current note changes via API.

methods.name: updateDraftAndAutosave
methods.description: Updates draft state and triggers autosave if a note is selected.

methods.name: removeTag
methods.description: Removes a tag from the note's tags.
